en: Mayon Volcano in Albay is a classic stratovolcano famous for its nearly perfect symmetrical cone.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines, stretching approximately 505 kilometers.
Lake Lanao in Mindanao is the largest lake in the southern Philippines and the second-largest in the country.
Mount Apo in Davao is the highest mountain in the Philippines, reaching an elevation of 2,954 meters.
The Philippine eagle is the largest eagle in the world in terms of length and wing surface.
The Philippine tarsier has eyes that are each as large as its entire brain.
Luzon is the largest island in the Philippines, accounting for about one-third of the country's total land area.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River features an eight-kilometer navigable underground river that flows directly into the sea.
The Philippine Trench, located east of the archipelago, reaches a maximum depth of over 10,500 meters.
Abaca, a species of banana plant native to the Philippines, produces the strongest natural fiber in the world.
The amihan is the cool northeast monsoon that brings dry weather to the Philippines between November and February.
Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park in the Sulu Sea protects over 600 species of fish and 360 species of coral.
